description.en: Small, fast instruction model with a very long native context. A good default for light chat, extraction and tool calling.
description.zh: 小巧快速的指令模型，原生支持超长上下文。适合轻量对话、信息抽取和工具调用。

description.en: General-purpose model that can switch between step-by-step thinking and quick answers. Strong all-rounder for a single GPU.
description.zh: 可在“思考”与快速回答之间切换的通用模型，单卡上的全能选手。

description.en: Larger Qwen3 with thinking and non-thinking modes; noticeably better at reasoning and writing than the 8B.
description.zh: 更大的 Qwen3，支持思考与非思考模式，推理和写作明显优于 8B。

description.en: The largest dense Qwen3. High-quality answers and reasoning when you have the memory for it.
description.zh: 最大的稠密 Qwen3，显存充足时回答与推理质量很高。

description.en: Mixture-of-experts model: 30B parameters but only about 3B active per token, so it answers quickly while knowing a lot.
description.zh: 混合专家模型：总参数 30B，每个 token 仅激活约 3B，知识面广且生成速度快。

description.en: Meta's widely used 8B instruction model with a 128K context. The original weights need an accepted licence on Hugging Face.
description.zh: Meta 广泛使用的 8B 指令模型，128K 上下文。原始权重需在 Hugging Face 上同意许可后下载。

description.en: Compact Llama for summarisation and simple assistants; runs comfortably next to other workloads.
description.zh: 紧凑的 Llama，适合摘要和简单助手，可与其他任务同时运行。

description.en: Google's open model that understands text and images, in the 4B size. The GGUF variants include the vision projector; the original weights need an accepted licence.
description.zh: Google 的开放模型，可理解文字和图片（4B 规格）。GGUF 版本自带视觉投影文件；原始权重需同意许可后下载。

description.en: Google's open model that understands text and images, in the 12B size. The GGUF variants include the vision projector; the original weights need an accepted licence.
description.zh: Google 的开放模型，可理解文字和图片（12B 规格）。GGUF 版本自带视觉投影文件；原始权重需同意许可后下载。

description.en: Google's open model that understands text and images, in the 27B size. The GGUF variants include the vision projector; the original weights need an accepted licence.
description.zh: Google 的开放模型，可理解文字和图片（27B 规格）。GGUF 版本自带视觉投影文件；原始权重需同意许可后下载。

description.en: Capable mid-size model with image input and reliable function calling.
description.zh: 能力均衡的中等规模模型，支持图片输入，函数调用可靠。

description.en: 14B model trained heavily on synthetic data; strong at maths and logic for its size, mainly English.
description.zh: 大量使用合成数据训练的 14B 模型，数学与逻辑能力出色，以英文为主。

description.en: OpenAI's open-weight reasoning model (mixture of experts, about 3.6B active) with adjustable reasoning effort.
description.zh: OpenAI 的开放权重推理模型（混合专家，约 3.6B 激活参数），可调节推理强度。

description.en: The large gpt-oss: frontier-style reasoning with about 5.1B active parameters per token. Needs a lot of GPU memory.
description.zh: 大型 gpt-oss：每个 token 约 5.1B 激活参数，推理能力强，需要大量显存。

description.en: Code-specialised Qwen2.5 (7B) for writing, explaining and completing code in many languages.
description.zh: 专注代码的 Qwen2.5（7B），擅长多语言代码编写、解释与补全。

description.en: Code-specialised Qwen2.5 (14B) for writing, explaining and completing code in many languages.
description.zh: 专注代码的 Qwen2.5（14B），擅长多语言代码编写、解释与补全。

description.en: Code-specialised Qwen2.5 (32B) for writing, explaining and completing code in many languages.
description.zh: 专注代码的 Qwen2.5（32B），擅长多语言代码编写、解释与补全。

description.en: Fast mixture-of-experts coding model built for agentic coding tools and long repositories.
description.zh: 面向智能体编程工具和大型代码库的快速混合专家代码模型。

description.en: Agentic coding model tuned for software-engineering agents that edit files and run tools.
description.zh: 为能编辑文件、调用工具的软件工程智能体调优的代码模型。

description.en: Qwen2.5 7B distilled from DeepSeek-R1: thinks out loud before answering, good at maths and logic puzzles.
description.zh: 由 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏的 Qwen2.5 7B：先思考再作答，擅长数学和逻辑题。

description.en: Qwen2.5 14B distilled from DeepSeek-R1: thinks out loud before answering, good at maths and logic puzzles.
description.zh: 由 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏的 Qwen2.5 14B：先思考再作答，擅长数学和逻辑题。

description.en: Qwen2.5 32B distilled from DeepSeek-R1: thinks out loud before answering, good at maths and logic puzzles.
description.zh: 由 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏的 Qwen2.5 32B：先思考再作答，擅长数学和逻辑题。

description.en: Qwen3 8B distilled from the May 2025 DeepSeek-R1; one of the strongest small reasoning models.
description.zh: 由 2025 年 5 月版 DeepSeek-R1 蒸馏的 Qwen3 8B，是最强的小型推理模型之一。

description.en: Qwen's dedicated reasoning model; long chains of thought for hard maths, science and coding questions.
description.zh: Qwen 的专用推理模型，用较长的思维链解决数学、科学和编程难题。

description.en: Multilingual text embeddings (0.6B) for search and retrieval-augmented generation; served on /v1/embeddings.
description.zh: 多语言文本向量模型（0.6B），用于检索和 RAG，通过 /v1/embeddings 提供服务。

description.en: Multilingual text embeddings (4B) for search and retrieval-augmented generation; served on /v1/embeddings.
description.zh: 多语言文本向量模型（4B），用于检索和 RAG，通过 /v1/embeddings 提供服务。

description.en: Multilingual text embeddings (8B) for search and retrieval-augmented generation; served on /v1/embeddings.
description.zh: 多语言文本向量模型（8B），用于检索和 RAG，通过 /v1/embeddings 提供服务。

description.en: Tiny, popular English embedding model; fast enough to share a GPU with anything.
description.zh: 小巧且流行的英文向量模型，速度快，可与任何任务共用显卡。

description.en: Multilingual embedding model from BAAI with long inputs; a common choice for Chinese and mixed-language search.
description.zh: BAAI 的多语言向量模型，支持长文本输入，中文及多语言检索的常用选择。

description.en: Vision-language model (3B) for screenshots, documents, charts and photos, including OCR.
description.zh: 视觉语言模型（3B），可理解截图、文档、图表和照片，支持 OCR。

description.en: Vision-language model (7B) for screenshots, documents, charts and photos, including OCR.
description.zh: 视觉语言模型（7B），可理解截图、文档、图表和照片，支持 OCR。

description.en: Vision-language model (32B) for screenshots, documents, charts and photos, including OCR.
description.zh: 视觉语言模型（32B），可理解截图、文档、图表和照片，支持 OCR。

description.en: Newest Qwen vision-language model (4B): image and document understanding, OCR and visual agents. Needs a recent llama.cpp / vLLM.
description.zh: 最新的 Qwen 视觉语言模型（4B）：图像与文档理解、OCR 和视觉智能体。需要较新的 llama.cpp / vLLM。

description.en: Newest Qwen vision-language model (8B): image and document understanding, OCR and visual agents. Needs a recent llama.cpp / vLLM.
description.zh: 最新的 Qwen 视觉语言模型（8B）：图像与文档理解、OCR 和视觉智能体。需要较新的 llama.cpp / vLLM。

description.en: Newest Qwen vision-language model (30B-A3B): image and document understanding, OCR and visual agents. Needs a recent llama.cpp / vLLM.
description.zh: 最新的 Qwen 视觉语言模型（30B-A3B）：图像与文档理解、OCR 和视觉智能体。需要较新的 llama.cpp / vLLM。
